meta.title: What Happened at the Cooking Class
meta.textType: story: a conversation about past events

paragraphs: On Monday at lunch, May sat next to Lily in the school hall. May had a cold on Saturday, so she stayed at home. Her nose was red, but she felt better. "Please tell me about the cooking class," she said. "My mom wants the recipe." "Do you feel better today?" asked Lily. "Yes, a little," said May.

"At the beginning, we went to the big shop in town," said Lily. "It has a food department on the ground floor." "Chef Lucy gave us a list of ingredients." "The shop was big, and there were many people at the fruit counter." "Leo carried the bag, and Mia held the list." "We bought three fresh mangoes, a bag of rice, and some sugar." "What happened next?" asked May.

"Next, Mia cut her finger on the paper bag," said Lily. "It was only a small cut, but she needed a bandage." "She held up her finger so that everybody could see." "It is nothing," she said. "We went to the pharmacy next to the shop." "A woman there gave her a small bandage with a green cat on it." "Mia laughed, and then we walked to the cooking class."

"Was the class far?" asked May. "No, it was only five minutes away," said Lily. "The room smelled of coconut, and it had four small tables." "Chef Lucy wore a blue shirt and a white hat." "She gave each of us a big spoon." "First, we washed the rice and cooked it in water." "Then Leo tried the rice before we added the sugar." "He said, 'It is awful!'" "Everybody laughed, even Chef Lucy." "Then Chef Lucy added the sugar, and we tried it again."

"After that, we cooked the rice with sugar and coconut," said Lily. "Chef Lucy cut the mangoes into thin pieces." "The pieces were yellow and sweet." "Finally, we put the mango on top of the rice." "It was delicious," said Lily. "Leo ate two plates, and he did not say awful again." "The class finished at noon, and we walked home." "Mia's bandage was still on her finger." "Leo took a photo of his empty plate." May laughed and wrote the words in her notebook. "Thank you," she said. "Now I can make it for my mom on Saturday."

sentences.text: On Monday at lunch, May sat next to Lily in the school hall.
May had a cold on Saturday, so she stayed at home.
Her nose was red, but she felt better.
"Please tell me about the cooking class," she said.
"My mom wants the recipe."
"Do you feel better today?" asked Lily.
"Yes, a little," said May.
"At the beginning, we went to the big shop in town," said Lily.
"It has a food department on the ground floor."
"Chef Lucy gave us a list of ingredients."
"The shop was big, and there were many people at the fruit counter."
"Leo carried the bag, and Mia held the list."
"We bought three fresh mangoes, a bag of rice, and some sugar."
"What happened next?" asked May.
"Next, Mia cut her finger on the paper bag," said Lily.
"It was only a small cut, but she needed a bandage."
"She held up her finger so that everybody could see."
"It is nothing," she said.
"We went to the pharmacy next to the shop."
"A woman there gave her a small bandage with a green cat on it."
"Mia laughed, and then we walked to the cooking class."
"Was the class far?" asked May.
"No, it was only five minutes away," said Lily.
"The room smelled of coconut, and it had four small tables."
"Chef Lucy wore a blue shirt and a white hat."
"She gave each of us a big spoon."
"First, we washed the rice and cooked it in water."
"Then Leo tried the rice before we added the sugar."
"He said, 'It is awful!'"
"Everybody laughed, even Chef Lucy."
"Then Chef Lucy added the sugar, and we tried it again."
"After that, we cooked the rice with sugar and coconut," said Lily.
"Chef Lucy cut the mangoes into thin pieces."
"The pieces were yellow and sweet."
"Finally, we put the mango on top of the rice."
"It was delicious," said Lily.
"Leo ate two plates, and he did not say awful again."
"The class finished at noon, and we walked home."
"Mia's bandage was still on her finger."
"Leo took a photo of his empty plate."
May laughed and wrote the words in her notebook.
"Thank you," she said.
"Now I can make it for my mom on Saturday."
